strings.98: Traditionally, every early spring, the Franks carry out a great sweep of their lands...

briefings.500:
<font:$local$\fonts\fonthead16bld.fnt>
THE GREAT SWEEP
<font:$local$\fonts\font12.fnt>
As every year in early spring, Sigurd's troops hold what they call the "Great Sweep" in their southernmost lands.

That is the knights' name for their fight against the Viking and Saracen tribes who came down from the north and up from the south during the winter to steal and lord it over Frankish land.

Yet these uncivilised heathen tribes never learn from their mistakes, and every year they come back hoping that this time their wicked plans will succeed.

<usericon:0,102>

This year Sigurd joined his troops in person to drive out the intruders with his own hands. Besides, he had nothing more interesting to do.

"Listen, men!" he shouted. "Prepare yourselves well for battle! It is time to show these wretched Saracens and Vikings that there is no place for them in the lands of the famous Sigurd!"

DEFEAT THE INTRUDERS!

 

~~ Made by Prajdo aka Brainy ~~
MAP VERSION 2.0
briefings.501:
We decided to open the chest we had kept for a rainy day.

The carrier pigeon locked inside quickly took to the air and flew off to the south.

Stay alert and wait for help!
briefings.502:
<font:$local$\fonts\fonthead16bld.fnt>
HATCHIE!
<font:$local$\fonts\font12.fnt>
The pigeon was much faster than we expected. It turned out it had flown to Hatchie's camp, and as usual he answered our call for help at once.

<usericon:1,9,453>

"Greetings, friends!" Hatchie said briskly. "I have come to help! Nobody knows how to fight raiders better than I do! We will beat them by exploiting their weaknesses!"



In the Land of Old Heroes the Saracen Hatchie received the gift of teleportation. From now on you will find an icon with his name in the tab for relations with other nations. There you can choose a place he will be moved to at once.
Remember to build a well first! You must also have visited the chosen "FIELD OF GLORY" before you can send the hero there.

<usericon:1,162,47>
briefings.503:
<font:$local$\fonts\fonthead16bld.fnt>
SPHINX
<font:$local$\fonts\font12.fnt>
When I found the Sphinx in the desert, curiosity got the better of me and I decided to take a closer look.

As usual, my intuition did not let me down. A button hidden under the sand set off some mechanism, which in turn made chests appear all around! What a strange thing!
briefings.504:
<font:$local$\fonts\fonthead16bld.fnt>
BJARNI!?!?!?
<font:$local$\fonts\font12.fnt>
Nobody had ever managed to surprise Sigurd and his solemn knights quite so much!

<usericon:1,477,189>

In the chest on the lake, which we opened after a great deal of trouble, we found our friend, the Viking chieftain Bjarni.

"Don't ever ask me how I got in there."

Bjarni stayed silent for several more hours, and his face was as red as Cyra's the summer she fell asleep sunbathing on the beach. Let's spare him any remarks. His pride could not take it...
briefings.505:
<font:$local$\fonts\fonthead16bld.fnt>
CYRA
<font:$local$\fonts\font12.fnt>
Ever since the druids placed magic portals in various places around the world to travel faster, life seems easier, especially for merchants. Now and then, though, using these passages leads to unpleasant mishaps.

<usericon:1,145,374>

That is just what happened when Cyra was travelling through the portals in Byzantium. The passage did not work properly and... our heroine landed in the middle of the fighting in Sigurd's lands!

Now that she is here, Cyra will surely help us fight the intruders. Afterwards she will probably go back to her duties. That gives her a while to think up a neat excuse for vanishing so suddenly, because nobody will ever believe she ended up in Frankish lands in an instant for no reason at all...
briefings.506:
This chest, far away in the west, held 50 Gold Coins, which have already been taken to one of your warehouses.

Exploring the area so thoroughly paid off. These must be coins the Saracens hid here after their raids.
briefings.507:
<font:$local$\fonts\fonthead16bld.fnt>
SARACEN CAMP
<font:$local$\fonts\font12.fnt>
Our people have found the Saracen camp in the south, beyond the sands of a small desert. The scoundrels built their camp practically on the trade route and right by the river! We will not let them lord it over this place any longer!

Defeat the hostile Saracens.
briefings.508:
<font:$local$\fonts\fonthead16bld.fnt>
VIKING CAMP
<font:$local$\fonts\font12.fnt>
In the north, beyond the forest, we have tracked down a garrison of wild Vikings who are plundering our lands. Now that their camp has been found, it is time to deal with the threat.

Defeat the hostile Vikings.
briefings.509:
<font:$local$\fonts\fonthead16bld.fnt>
VICTORY!!
<font:$local$\fonts\font12.fnt>
We did it! Sigurd's men have driven every last enemy from their lands and shown that nobody trifles with them.

"I had a splendid time," said Sigurd. "Next year I will surely ride with you again, my knights, if anyone still dares to come back here after meeting me!"
briefings.510:
<font:$local$\fonts\fonthead16bld.fnt>
DEFEAT...
<font:$local$\fonts\font12.fnt>
If any of the heroes dies during the game, you are defeated and the mission cannot go on...

<picture:$local$\graphics\Hero_Dead_F.pcx>
briefings.511:
It was not without reason that Sigurd had the garrison placed right here, between two mountain ranges and the river. 

They make excellent natural fortifications. It will be easier to hold out should the invaders attack.


In the fight against the aggressor you will also have two lifelines:

The first is a donation of 5 gold coins to the Frankish Castle in the west. Once you pay it, you can recruit trained knights. This help can be used again and again.

The second way out is to call in an ally with a carrier pigeon.

<usericon:1,304,242>

The pigeon is locked in this very chest east of the camp. It can be used only once, and first you must clear the barrier with a catapult.

Remember that the enemy tribes will not necessarily wait for you to make the first move. It is worth putting your resources into defence early on.

GOOD LUCK!
briefings.512:
<usericon:1,9,453>

We paid the promised donation, and well-trained knights came from the Castle to fight for the just cause.
briefings.513:
Sigurd does not regret for a moment that he decided to join this year's crusade.

For we have come upon a band of lost souls - warriors of a famous battle who fought fiercely here years ago to defend their homeland. Sadly they fell, because the reinforcements they were promised turned out to be in league with the enemy.

Now the lost souls trust no one, and they fight everyone in defence of their land even after death.

"How thrilling to defeat such splendid warriors," said Sigurd. "Perhaps we should leave them in peace and respect their resolve, but these lands are mine now, and I answer for every civilian whose trade route runs through here. Sadly, ghosts cannot tell friend from foe, so at last we must send them on to the other world."

If you wish, you can destroy the band of legendary warriors' souls.
briefings.514:
<font:$local$\fonts\fonthead16bld.fnt>
CONGRATULATIONS!
<font:$local$\fonts\font12.fnt>
You managed to gather all four heroes and bring them safely to Sigurd's Garrison!

<usericon:0,102> <usericon:0,100> <usericon:0,101> <usericon:0,103>

As a reward you receive a troop of mighty warriors straight from the Byzantine Empire! 

<usericon:1,145,374>

Now the enemy does not stand a chance!
briefings.515:
You chose to eliminate the threat of the Ghost Warriors roaming the forests around here.

From now on the trail to the Magic Passages, the teleports in the northeast, is safe.
briefings.516:
The chest seems to hold the deed to a fishing boat and a little map showing exactly where it lies.

<usericon:1,450,209>

Perhaps it is worth sailing out onto the lake where it is moored?
briefings.517:
<font:$local$\fonts\fonthead16bld.fnt>
MYSTERIOUS CLOUDS
<font:$local$\fonts\font12.fnt>

Bjarni's presence at once made mysterious clouds appear.

<usericon:1,96,338>

Our hero gained superhuman powers during his adventures in the Land of Old Heroes. Wherever he goes, misty clouds appear, in which he can quite literally look deep into his own soul and split off his worst traits, the ones he keeps buried from day to day.
In practice this means he can bring his alter ego to life.

Don't be afraid to use this power on risky missions! The summoned Inrajb is just waiting to be thrown into mindless battle. This mad masochist has the soul of a berserker and simply loves dying in combat, and when he falls, Bjarni's next visit to the mist brings him straight back.
